title: My 2nd purchase, poor quality!
text: My 2nd purchase, poor quality!. I ordered this once before and the quality was excellent. I ordered a second set for my mobile home and it was really cheap and not nearly the same quality as the first set that I bought. The first set I bought was so heavy, I used 2 hands to lift it, this set is lightweight and the cheap plastic bottoms do not hold the set in place when you are lifting out the silverware. Very disappointing. Until this seller can prove that the quality is the same as before, I would avoid.
